subject: Privileged exit: Rohan Mehta — offboarding, data preservation & customer access
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Privileged exit: Rohan Mehta - urgent offboarding and data preservation

Team —

I need to escalate a sensitive personnel decision that needs immediate offboarding and evidence preservation. Leadership approved involuntary separation for Rohan Mehta (last day to be determined); HR/legal asked me to coordinate the operational pieces so we don’t risk data loss or privileged access exposure.

High-level asks: 
- Monica: lock schedule for an in-person termination meeting today at 15:00 PST and prepare offers/severance papers. I attached the decision memo and a draft access matrix.
- Karthik: we need forensic preservation instructions (mailbox/legal hold, laptop image). Please advise on what to pause/delete and what to archive.
- Technical owners: immediately suspend any customer-facing credentials tied to Rohan, but do NOT purge backups or delete repos until legal signs off.

Critical external considerations: Rohan had admin-level keys to the Acme Corp project and direct Slack threads with their SREs. We should loop in Acme and external counsel about notification timing after we have preserved evidence.

Attachments: termination_decision.pdf, access_matrix.xlsx

I’ll be available to coordinate. Please confirm next steps ASAP.

Ben
VP, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Privileged exit: Rohan Mehta - urgent offboarding and data preservation

Thanks Ben — I have the 15:00 slot reserved and will lead the meeting.

Immediate operational checklist (I will own coordination unless you reassign):
- Termination meeting 15:00 PST (Monica + Ben + Rohan) — objective: deliver decision, next steps, severance offer.
- Payroll & benefits: draft severance, final paycheck, PTO payout, COBRA options (Payroll team notified).
- Access: prepare deprovision request for G Suite, Slack, AWS, GitHub, PagerDuty, Datadog, Okta. Do NOT execute until after the meeting unless instructed by legal.
- Devices: collect company laptop and phone on exit — arrange for forensic image prior to wipe.
- Customer handoff: prepare note for Emma Foster (Acme) to inform them of a point-of-contact change; I will draft language pending legal.
- Evidence: will place immediate legal hold on Rohan's mailbox and Drive as requested by Karthik.

Attachments: separation_checklist.pdf (initial version)

Questions for Ben/Karthik:
1) Confirm whether Rohan should be escorted from office after the meeting (yes/no).
2) Any limitation on discussing details with Rohan about code/doc copies he requests — legal to advise.

I will circulate an action-owners table within 30 minutes.

—Monica
Sr. HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lindsay Park <lindsay@litigatepartners.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Privileged exit: Rohan Mehta - urgent offboarding and data preservation

Thanks for the heads-up. A few legal preservation notes — please follow these exactly and confirm when complete: 

1) Preservation vs. deprovision: do NOT delete or purge any data (mailbox, Drive, Slack exports, GitHub repos, S3 buckets, snapshots). We should freeze account activity where possible but create forensic images/exports before any wipes.

2) Mailbox & Drive: place a legal hold on Rohan's G Suite mailbox and Drive. Generate PST/mbox export and store in our secure evidence bucket (forensic bucket).

3) Devices: image corporate laptop and phone prior to return; chain-of-custody form to accompany hardware. IT should not re-image the laptop or factory-reset the phone.

4) Git/Code: create an export of Rohan's repositories and an access report (who pushed/merged in last 90 days). Revoke tokens, rotate any service account keys Rohan managed, but archive repos as read-only snapshots.

5) Customer notification: coordinate with Acme and Lindsay (external counsel) before sending any customer communication. Do not notify customers until we confirm evidence preservation steps are completed.

6) Communicate policy: advise Rohan that he must not attempt to access or transfer company data; that will be in writing during the meeting.

I attached a short forensic_instructions.docx. Once Monica confirms the checklist items, Lindsay and I will finalize notice timing.

—Karthik
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Privileged exit: Rohan Mehta - urgent offboarding and data preservation

Rohan —

Please join Monica and me at 15:00 in conference room B for a personnel meeting. Monica will walk through next steps and severance options. I know this is difficult; our objective is to be direct and respectful.

A few important items before the meeting: 
- Do not access company systems or contact customers until the meeting concludes.
- We will collect company devices; Monica will coordinate logistics.
- If you have personal files that are not company property (personal notes, some photos), bring a list and we will review per policy.

Monica: I will be present. Karthik copied previously will provide legal instructions and evidence hold.

Ben
VP, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

- Personal notes: I have some personal design notes and photos on the laptop. I’d like to request copies of personal files that are not company property.
- Customer handoffs: I understand Acme will be notified; please let me know who their new contact will be so I can provide a clean handover.
